# reading result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:readingResult`](gmeow-readingResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/readingResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

The lexical form(s) produced by a reading. Non-functional: a single reading may yield multiple coexisting forms (e.g. ambiguous or damaged signs interpreted differently within the same analytical frame), and competing result claims from different readings coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InscriptionReading`](../classes/gmeow-InscriptionReading.md) -> [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md)

Use [`gmeow:readingResult`](gmeow-readingResult.md) from [`gmeow:InscriptionReading`](../classes/gmeow-InscriptionReading.md) to [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
